name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
des: The AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme is a flagship initiative of the Ministry of Education, Government of India, implemented by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). Launched in November 2014, it provides annual financial assistance of ₹50,000 to specially-abled (differently abled) students pursuing full-time technical diploma or degree courses at AICTE-approved institutions. The scheme aims to ensure that physical disability does not become a barrier to quality technical education. A total of 1,000 scholarships are awarded annually. The scholarship is provided as a lump sum to cover tuition fees, books, stationery, computers, software, and educational equipment. No additional grants are given for hostel fees or medical charges. Amount is disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) on an annual basis.
benefits: ₹50,000 financial assistance per year as a lump sum (no separate hostel/medical grants)
For Degree students: scholarship available for up to 4 years
For Diploma students: scholarship available for up to 3 years
For Lateral Entry (2nd year direct admission): up to 3 years for degree, up to 2 years for diploma
Amount can be used for tuition fees, books, stationery, computers, software, and educational equipment
1,000 scholarships awarded annually (no upper cap on applications)
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-linked bank account on annual basis
Scholarship renewable each year upon successful academic progression
criteria: Student must be specially-abled with a minimum 40% disability as certified by a government medical board
Disability Certificate must be issued by a government medical board only (private hospital certificates not accepted)
Must be admitted to the 1st year of a full-time technical Degree or Diploma course at an AICTE-approved institution
Lateral entry students admitted directly to 2nd year of Degree/Diploma are also eligible
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000
Must be pursuing a full-time course only — part-time, distance, or correspondence courses are NOT eligible
Student must not be receiving any other Central/State government or AICTE-sponsored scholarship simultaneously
For renewal: student must pass and be promoted to the next year — failure to promote results in forfeiture of scholarship
required_documents: Disability Certificate issued by a government medical board (must specify percentage of disability — minimum 40%)
Aadhaar Card (mandatory for DBT; alternatives: Voter ID, Driving License, PAN, Passport)
Annual Income Certificate of parents/guardian (family income ≤ ₹8 lakh)
Admission Letter for Degree/Diploma technical course from AICTE-approved institution
Fee Receipt for current academic year
Class 12th Certificate and Marksheet (for degree course applicants)
For renewal: Passing Certificate/Marksheet of previous year and verification letter from Head of Institution
application_process: Visit the National Scholarship Portal (NSP): https://scholarships.gov.in
Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar-linked mobile number and face authentication via OTR mobile app
Login to NSP and click on 'Apply for Scholarship'
Select 'AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially Abled Students' under AICTE schemes
Fill in personal details, disability details, academic details, and bank account information
Upload all required documents in .jpg, .pdf, or .png format as per specified file size limits
Review all details and submit the application before the deadline (typically October 31)
Application is reviewed by your institution and the State/UT Technical Education Department
Approved candidates are listed on the AICTE portal — check status using Application ID on NSP
For renewal each year: submit renewal form with marksheet and Head of Institution verification letter on NSP
